# Mini app API

<!-- Generated by `bun run check:mini-app-contract --write` from the mini app kit. Do not edit. -->

What a mini app may rely on from Localix. A change here changes every mini app: removing or
changing anything below needs a new `MINI_APP_API_VERSION`.

## module @localixai/mini-app-sdk/bounded-cache

### BoundedCache

```ts
export interface BoundedCache<K, V> {
    get(key: K): V | undefined;
    peek(key: K): V | undefined;
    has(key: K): boolean;
    set(key: K, value: V): boolean;
    delete(key: K): boolean;
    deleteWhere(predicate: (value: V, key: K) => boolean): void;
    clear(): void;
    readonly size: number;
    readonly weight: number;
}
```

### BoundedCacheOptions

```ts
export interface BoundedCacheOptions<K, V> {
    maxEntries: number;
    maxWeight?: number;
    weigh?: (value: V, key: K) => number;
    onEvict?: (key: K, value: V) => void;
}
```

### createBoundedCache

```ts
export declare function createBoundedCache<K, V>({ maxEntries, maxWeight, weigh, onEvict, }: BoundedCacheOptions<K, V>): BoundedCache<K, V>;
```

```ts
type MenuEntry = MenuActionEntry | MenuHeaderEntry | MenuSeparatorEntry | MenuSubmenuEntry;
```

```ts
type MenuHeaderEntry = {
    header: string;
};
```

### kit/workbench-statusbar.d.ts#MenuSeparatorEntry

```ts
type MenuSeparatorEntry = {
    separator: true;
};
```

### kit/workbench-statusbar.d.ts#MenuSubmenuEntry

```ts
type MenuSubmenuEntry = {
    description?: string | undefined;
    disabled?: boolean | undefined;
    emptyLabel?: string | undefined;
    hint?: string | undefined;
    icon?: IconComponent | undefined;

};
```

### kit/workbench-statusbar.d.ts#StatusItemState

```ts
type StatusItemState = {
    Icon?: IconComponent | undefined;
    active?: boolean | undefined;
    badge?: undefined | {
        count: number;
    } | {
        dot: true;
    };
    busy?: boolean | undefined;
    chordId?: string | undefined;
    label: string;
    menu?: readonly MenuEntry[] | undefined;
    metrics?: readonly StatusMetric[] | undefined;
    onClick?: (() => void) | undefined;
    text?: string | undefined;
    tone?: StatusTone | undefined;
};
```

### kit/workbench-statusbar.d.ts#StatusMetric

```ts
type StatusMetric = {
    icon?: IconComponent | undefined;

    tone?: StatusTone | undefined;
    value: string;
};
```

### kit/workbench-statusbar.d.ts#StatusTone

```ts
type StatusTone = "error" | "info" | "neutral" | "success" | "warning";
```
